title: Sheldrake's plant research at an agricultural institute in India

tellings.quote: I spent years in India working in an agricultural Research Institute on um breeding chick better chick peas and pigeon peas

plain: Before his better-known work, the scientist Rupert Sheldrake spent years in India at a farming research institute, breeding better chickpeas and pigeon peas. Sheldrake tells this about himself to Jesse Michels as part of his own life story, which shows him grounded in practical plant science.
